# Codevenient Consulting

> Digital solutions consultancy that designs and builds websites, booking
> systems and online stores for small and medium businesses, based in
> Mahikeng, South Africa.

Codevenient plans every project like a real structure before building it —
discovery, design, build, then ongoing measurement — rather than starting
from a generic template.

## Services
- Brand & marketing websites — fast, distinctive sites built to rank and convert on mobile
- Booking & scheduling systems — automated calendars, deposits and reminders
- E-commerce builds — catalogue, checkout and stock management tuned to sell
